title.orig: An Act Declaring April 3 of Every Year a Special Non-Working Holiday in the Municipality of Luisiana, Province of Laguna to Celebrate the "Araw ng Lubusang Kalayaan Bilang Bayan ng Luisiana, Laguna" and the "Pandanan Festival"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2007/ra_9413_2007.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: April 3 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the Municipal1ty of Luisiana. Province of Laguna to celebrate the "Araw ng Lubusang Kalayaan Bilang Bayan ng Luisiana, Laguna" and the "Pandanan Festival".
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its complete publication in at least two newspapers of general circulation in the Philippines.
